$comment: The second checker's rule register: the rules checker2 (packages/checker2) implements over the PG grammar's shape tree, sharing no code with the kernel. The register only grows as rules are re-implemented, and the leg errors on drift in either direction — an implemented rule missing from the register, or a registered rule the implementation does not carry. Every corpus case whose expectation stays within the implemented set runs through BOTH implementations under the same runner; the rest wait for their rules (the first slice: the structural family C1, C2, C4, C10, C11, C96, C109). The outOfSurface map declares the ids the runtime catalog carries but no single-package checker can mirror (a retired construct, the diff surface, the reserved math plane) — the parity boundary is visible, never silent.
